title: My Mall World
content: First wow on finding this. I have dreams all the time of this universe. The malls are multi leveled. Their is Roots stores, Radio Shacks and other stores now gone. There is stores I have never heard of. Most times I am being chased, other times I am a thief, shoplifter or just searching for a specific item. I sometimes am not trying to steal, but notice I am being watched… on these occasions I find my self checking my pockets to make sure I didn’t unknowingly take something. I have been chased by crazy groups wanting to harm me, police wanting to question me, or friends rushing me while I am trying to find a specific item in a store. I am always in stores with high end clothing. Far West and NorthFace are the 2 most occurring brands. Followed by Roots and Tandy(radio shack) merchandise. The exits leaving the mall are pretty much nonexistent. I have been chased and chased up and down stairs. I hide in stores…. I hide in hidden tunnels used as merchants for stocking their stores. I have never been caught by mall security, by the police. I have seen friends apprehended but I always avoid it happening to me…. Sometimes the mall is connected to an even bigger hotel, or apartment building. Some times I take a merchant or service corridor that opens up too a huge factory that is no longer operational.
